title: Preimage of a standard chart under a morphism to projective space given by sections
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $n\ge0$, and $\mathbf P^n_S=S\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ with $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n])$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], projections $q_n=\mathrm{pr}_1$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2:\mathbf P^n_S\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$. For $j\in\{0,\dots,n\}$ let $D_+(T_j)_S=\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$, and for $l\in\{0,\dots,n\}$ let $u_{l/j}\in\Gamma(D_+(T_j)_S,\mathcal O)$ be the pullback by $\mathrm{pr}_2$ of the function $T_l/T_j\in\Gamma(D_+(T_j),\mathcal O)=\mathbf Z[T_0/T_j,\dots,T_n/T_j]$. Let $g:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ global sections generating $\mathcal L$, and $\varphi=\varphi_{g,(\mathcal L,(s_i))}:Y\to\mathbf P^n_S$ the morphism of [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]. For a global section $s$ of $\mathcal L$ write $Y_s=\{y\in Y: s(y)\neq0 \text{ in } \mathcal L_y\otimes\kappa(y)\}$ (an open set on which $s$ trivializes $\mathcal L$). Then for every $j$: (i) $\varphi^{-1}(D_+(T_j)_S)=Y_{s_j}$; (ii) for every $l$, $\varphi^*(u_{l/j})\in\Gamma(Y_{s_j},\mathcal O)$ is the unique function $a$ with $s_l|_{Y_{s_j}}=a\,s_j|_{Y_{s_j}}$ (written $s_l/s_j$).
